duration_days around 80-100, not period_type=ytd. If a result has derived=true,
use its derivation and components as evidence and do not calculate that fact

model_found_value. interpretations is required and may be empty. Every non-empty
item must be an evidence id like E3 — never free text.

"up", or "fell" (for example, "about $1.4 billion", "up 22%", or
"fell 10%"). For a change_pct, stated_value is 22 for 22%, not 0.22; the

function.name: lookup_fact
function.description: Look up one SEC EDGAR XBRL fact for a ticker, metric, and calendar quarter, fiscal quarter (FY2025Q4), or fiscal year. Successful results include period (the normalized requested label, or the resolved label for latest), period_basis (calendar or fiscal), fiscal_equals_calendar, duration_days, and period_type (quarter, ytd, annual, or instant). Additive flows may return derived=true with derivation and components; never treat a ytd result as a quarter or recompute a derived result. When fiscal_equals_calendar is true, fiscal and calendar labels identify the same fact; do not look up both readings.

function.name: list_periods
function.description: List the recent directly available SEC EDGAR quarter and fiscal-year periods for a ticker and metric.

function.name: compute_change
function.description: Compute the absolute and year-over-year change for one SEC EDGAR XBRL metric. The period and base_period must be the same kind of period; when base_period is omitted, null, empty, "null", or "none", use the same quarter or fiscal year one year earlier. The result includes both cited lookup facts, fiscal_equals_calendar, and a percentage change in percent points.

function.name: history_rank
function.description: Compare one quarter or fiscal-year fact with every available comparable period of the same period_type. Quarters include derived Q4 values when available; annual periods are compared only with annual periods. Return the rank, record flags through the requested period, prior high/low, and the comparison window with period end dates.
